# 22 — Produce a scaling recommendation

## Objective
Evaluate which parts of this golden path could transfer to another team or application.
## Required context and areas
Use workshop evidence, review decisions, risk/test findings, and `SCALING-RECOMMENDATION-TEMPLATE.md`.
## Change constraints
Recommendation only. Do not claim measured productivity or assurance without evidence.
## Response format
Scope; reusable activities; benefits; limitations; governance; prerequisites; SME controls; pilot recommendation and measures.
## Assumptions
Different codebases, data classifications, and Copilot surfaces require revalidation.
## Validation and evidence
Link every claimed benefit to workshop evidence or label it hypothesis; record reviewer and open questions.
